provenance.method: Built-in imagegen original paired artwork; native Canvas deterministic component extraction, one frozen bundle scale, translations and verified alpha-1 background cleanup. No procedural drawing or shield overlay.

limitations: Original small and repeated walking/punching leg phases remain.
North cast repair reduces arm lift amplitude; release stays at original frame 3.
Hit silhouettes average about 9% taller than original; locked family scale was retained, without per-action fitting.
Far-side shield can be hidden by torso in northeast/east views.
Death E6 uses a five-pixel packing translation for transparent margin; original duration and profile unchanged.
Alpha-1 detached and distant background noise was removed by the documented shared processor; all alpha>=2 pixels and nearby antialiasing remain protected.
